01

Upgrade System

Stone stages and equipment upgrade caps

Equipment enhancements cover upgrade stones, rune and soul rune progression, regrade keys, enchantments, gems, and glyphs.

01
Equipment upgradesUpgrade Stones, Legendary Stones, Awakened Stones, Relic Stones, and Dark Stones define the main gear upgrade path.
02
Runes and emblemsHealing Emblems and Soul Runes use rune, soul, awakened, and relic stones through their own upgrade ranges.
03
Regrades and gemsRegrade keys open the grade path, while gems tune bonuses such as health, mana, damage, resistance, essence, and loot.
04
Enchantments and glyphsEnchantments add proc effects to weapons, wands, or shields, while glyphs give two active character slots.

StageDescriptionHow to Obtain
FirstUp to level +10 you can use Upgrade Stones or Catchup Stones.Acquired from monster essences, archlight crates, wild bosses, quests.
SecondTo upgrade your gear from +11 to +20 you have to use Legendary Stones.Acquired from monster essences, quests, sigils and transmuting upgrade stones or soul and rune soils.
ThirdTo upgrade your gear from +21 to +30 you have to use Awakened Stones.Acquired from monster essences, quests, sigils and transmuting Legendary Stones.
ForthTo upgrade your gear from +31 to +40 you have to use Relic Stones.Acquired from monster essences, quests, sigils and transmuting Awakened Stones.
LastTo upgrade your gear from +41 to +50 you have to use Dark Stones.Trade with Npc Aaron in Minerva's Isle, for the cost of 10 Darkness Shard, 5 Relic Stone, 1k ATs and 50kk Gold

Bulk Upgrades

Items and runes can be upgraded in bulk while respecting each item or rune level cap. Bulk upgrading applies to Upgrade Stones of all types, Soul Soil of all types, and Rune Soil of all types.

Catchup Box Materials

Later in a season, the catchup box can include regrade keys up to level 7, Stat Stones, Upgrade Stones, Legendary Stones, Relic Stones, Rune Soil, Awakened Rune Stones, Relic Rune Stones, Soul Soil, Awakened Soul Stones, and Relic Soul Stones. These catchup materials are listed as soulbound.

Dark Stone Path

Dark Stones remain the final listed upgrade stage for equipment. The current Blacksmithing source lists Dark Stone with an Archlight Token cost and no separate specialization transmute.

02

Healing Emblems and Soul Runes

Rune upgrade progression

Healing Rune is equipped next to the boots and provides the main source of healing for most vocations. Soul Rune is the main source of damage for most vocations.

At the beginning of the season, players receive a Soul Rune after reaching level 300. If lost, it can be bought from the rune seller NPC at depot floor +1, south east.

StageDescriptionHow to Obtain
FirstUp to level +10 you can use Rune Soil/Soul Soils or Catchup Rune/Soul Stones.Acquired from monster essences, archlight crates, wild bosses, quests, ritual bags, legendary keys, heirloom crates and by breaking all type of higher stones at blacksmithing station. (Awakened & Relic).
SecondFrom +10 to +15 you can use Awakened Rune/Awakened Soul stone.Acquired from monster essences, archlight crates, wild bosses, quests, ritual bags, legendary keys, heirloom crates and by breaking all type of higher stones at blacksmithing station. (Relic).
ThirdFrom +15 to +20 you can use Relic Rune/Relic Soul stone.Acquired from monster essences, archlight crates, wild bosses, quests, ritual bags, legendary keys, heirloom crates and by breaking all type of higher stones at blacksmithing station.
LastFrom +20 to +25 you can use Relic Rune/Relic Soul stone.Acquired from monster essences, archlight crates, wild bosses, quests, ritual bags, legendary keys, heirloom crates. Available after you buy the rune enhancement token (Sold from Gustavo 1.5k Wargate currency). Have to use one on each rune/emblem.
03

Enchantments

Weapon, wand, and shield enchantment cards

There are 8 different enchantment types on Archlight Online, and enchantments can be used on weapons, wands, or shields. Once an item is enchanted, the enchantment is consumed but remains on the item unless replaced.

Weapon and wand enchantments activate when hitting targets. Shield enchantments activate when taking hits. Most enchantments have a 10% proc chance unless stated otherwise.

Enchanter Specialization

Alchemy specialization is named Enchanter and supports Ascended Enchantment, listed as Tier 4. The craftsman bonus can improve elixirs and oil rolls, with better odds for polishing oils and higher values on shining oils.

Enchantment Crafting Costs

Empowered Enchantments use an increased Archlight Token cost. T4 Enchantments use both a large gold cost and a larger Archlight Token cost. The Enchanter Station also has reduced Forged Polishing Oil requirements in the latest listed station-cost pass.

Grip Enchanting Rule

Grip enchanting requires the Enchanter Olympus Bonus in the grip. The interface now explains this requirement when the player tries to enchant a grip.

Gems and Regrades

Slots, keys, diminishing returns, and gem tiers

Gems are a major equipment enhancement layer. Each helmet, armor, legs, boots, and weapon can have up to 8 gem slots opened with Regrade Keys.

Gem placement matters because item read order and diminishing returns affect the final value.

Overcharged and Surging GemsOvercharged Gems are crafted through Jewelcrafting. Surging Gems are crafted directly and use the matching Overcharged Gem as an ingredient.
05

Glyphs

Two active glyphs and rarity rolling
Icon

Each character can have 2 active glyphs at the same time. The system lists 10 different types with 4 grades: Artifact, Mystical, Relic, and Ancient.

Glyphs are located at the top right. Players can visit Ginger in the Stronghold and pay 100 glyph tokens for 1 glyph of their choice. Purchased glyphs have a chance to upgrade to a higher rarity.

Market and Item Support

The market supports custom attributes, initially including Soul Shards and Glyphs. This makes glyph-bearing and custom-attribute items easier to search and evaluate through the market.

Glyph Token Sources

Glyph Tokens appear in several update reward pools, including Bestiary rewards, Ramparts rewards, roulette additions, and token boosters. Ginger in the Stronghold remains the listed glyph-choice NPC for spending Glyph Tokens.
